annotations.title: Write a robots.txt that lets in only the AI bots you want

description: Builds a robots.txt from a simple choice: AI training in or out, AI search in or out, assistants in or out. Keeps every rule in the existing file (pass it as robots_txt), removes old lines for the AI bots it manages, and adds one clearly labelled block, including the shared User-agent: __usage_ai-training preference. Never touches Googlebot, Bingbot or Applebot, so normal search is unaffected.

ai_search.description: AI search and answer engines (default in).

assistants.description: Assistants that open a page because a person asked (default in).

training.description: Let AI training bots in or keep them out (default out).
